lines.text: Many learners say: He is a friend of me.
Better: He is a friend of mine.
In “a friend of ___,” use mine, not me.
Mine! She is a friend of mine.

native.hook: 「a friend of me」、me じゃなくて…？
native.tip: 「私の友達の一人」は a friend of mine。この形では of の後ろは me ではなく mine。
native.caption: “He is a friend of me.”と言っていませんか？😅 「私の友達」を「friend of me」と直訳しがちですが、正しくは mine を使います。“He is a friend of mine.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“mine”。a friend of mine が正しい形。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: In this phrase, say a friend of mine, not of me.
en.caption: Do you say “He is a friend of me.”? 😅 Say mine, not me, after of. The natural way is “He is a friend of mine.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
